meta.lfc_def: log2((cpm_pert+1)/(cpm_ctrl_mean+1)); CPM normalized over each file's own var space, then restricted to genes shared by both files and >5 CPM in both control profiles
meta.null_def: exhaustive off-diagonal of the matched-perturbation cross-similarity matrix (K562 pert i vs RPE1 pert j, i != j)
meta.mean_removal_def: per source, subtract the mean LFC vector across ALL non-control rows in that file
